note: Expected values were derived by Contracts/fixtures/derive-expected-values.py, a third implementation independent of both SDKs. Two SDKs agreeing with each other would prove nothing; agreeing with an outside implementation is the actual evidence.

vectors.name: revoked-key-before-proof-check
vectors.why: revocation is decided before the proof is verified, so a revoked key with a perfectly valid proof still reports SESSION_REVOKED rather than PROOF_INVALID

vectors.name: revoked-key-with-stale-proof
vectors.why: revocation also precedes the expiry check, so the reason never depends on timing

vectors.name: unrevoked-key-still-accepted
vectors.why: revoking one key does not revoke the rest
